criteria.requirement: Add optional attribute_provider=None to DictExporter. A callable receives each visited node and returns a mapping or finite key/value iterable. Use only explicitly supplied fields, then apply existing attriter/dictcls; never enumerate arbitrary slots or properties. Exclude parent/children and NodeMixin/LightNodeMixin structural private fields from provider results. Require string attribute keys, propagate provider errors, preserve maxlevel/childiter and ordinary __dict__ export. Support LightNodeMixin-only slots nodes and normal DictImporter round trips without hidden structure leakage.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
